title: Revisiting Multi-Agent Debate as Test-Time Scaling: A Systematic Study of Conditional Effectiveness
reasoning: The paper includes a significant systematic investigation of 'safety reasoning' as one of its two primary task domains. It evaluates the ability of LLMs to refuse harmful prompts using safety datasets (Anthropic Harmful Prompts and MultiJail) and explicitly utilizes an 'Ethical' agent persona defined as ensuring responses are 'morally sound, lawful, and socially responsible.'
